vector.description: Offered case (1) malformed stdout, stderr-fallback variant (§5.2/§5.3/§7.2): the verifier writes a schema-valid `allow` verdict to STDERR and nothing to stdout, exiting 0. §5.3 says hosts MUST NOT parse stderr for the verdict and §5.2 says empty stdout is a fail-closed condition, so the host MUST deny with failure_class unparseable_stdout. Catches a 'helpful' host that falls back to stderr when stdout is empty — such a host passes every other vector because no existing fixture writes to stderr. Only stdout is the verdict channel.
